name: org.openrewrite.gradle.migrate.artifacts.DependencyUseStringNotation
displayName: Use `String` notation for Gradle dependency declarations
description: In Gradle, dependencies can be expressed as a `String` like `"groupId:artifactId:version"`, or equivalently as a `Map` like `group: 'groupId', name: 'artifactId', version: 'version'`, or as positional parameters like `("groupId", "artifactId", "version")`. name: org.openrewrite.gradle.migrate.artifacts.MigrateHttpRepositories
displayName: Use HTTPS or allow the insecure protocol for `http://` repositories
description: Gradle 7.0 rejects repositories with an `http://` URL unless they opt in to the insecure protocol. A repository on a well-known public host that also serves HTTPS, such as Maven Central, the Gradle Plugin Portal or the Aliyun mirror, switches to `https://`. Any other `http://` repository, such as an internal repository manager or `localhost`, keeps its URL and gets `allowInsecureProtocol = true`, or `isAllowInsecureProtocol = true` in the Kotlin DSL, so the build keeps resolving from it.

name: org.openrewrite.gradle.migrate.artifacts.OneDependencyDeclarationPerStatement
displayName: Use one dependency declaration per statement
description: The Gradle Groovy DSL accepts multiple coordinates in a single configuration call (e.g. `implementation 'a:b:1.0', 'c:d:2.0'`), but the Kotlin DSL does not. Gradle's best practices recommend declaring a single dependency per statement; see the [Gradle dependency best practices](https://docs.gradle.org/current/userguide/best_practices_dependencies.html). This recipe splits multi-coordinate Groovy DSL configuration calls into one call per coordinate. Run this as a cleanup pass before other dependency-aware recipes (e.g. `UpgradeDependencyVersion`, `ChangeDependency`, `RemoveDependency`): those recipes use the `GradleDependency` trait, which only inspects the first argument of a configuration call. Coordinates in later positions are invisible to them until this recipe reshapes the source into one declaration per statement.

name: org.openrewrite.gradle.migrate.artifacts.RewriteSpreadAllInConfigurationsBlock
displayName: Replace spread-`all*` calls in `configurations` blocks with `configurations.all { }`
description: Gradle 9 throws `Cannot mutate the dependencies of configuration ':all' after the configuration was resolved.` when a `configurations { }` closure uses Groovy's spread-dot form `all*.<method>(args)`. Rewrite each such call to the closure form `configurations.all { <method>(args) }`, which preserves eager-`all` semantics but is accepted by Gradle 9. In mixed blocks, contiguous spread calls are grouped in `all { }` closures, leaving named configurations and other statements in place.

description: `Configuration.visible` has had no effect since Gradle 9.0, and is deprecated for removal in Gradle 11. Gradle 9.8.2 warns on `setVisible` where Gradle 8.14.4 does not. name: org.openrewrite.gradle.migrate.artifacts.UseAssembleDependsOnInsteadOfArchives
displayName: Make `assemble` depend on a task instead of adding it to the `archives` configuration
description: Gradle 9.1 deprecates adding artifacts to the `archives` configuration, which will fail in Gradle 10. What the declaration does is have `assemble` build the artifact, so this recipe replaces `artifacts { archives x }` with `tasks.named("assemble") { dependsOn(x) }`, as the upgrade guide says. Only tasks and task providers declared in the script, and `jar`, are replaced. Files, maps and a declaration with a configuration closure are left alone, and so is every script that mentions `uploadArchives` or otherwise reads the `archives` configuration, such as `sign configurations.archives`, since those depend on its artifacts. name: org.openrewrite.gradle.migrate.artifacts.UseAssignmentForRepositoryUrl
displayName: Use `=` assignment syntax for a repository's `url`
description: Setting a property with the Gradle-generated `propName value` syntax is deprecated since Gradle 8.14 and scheduled for removal in Gradle 10. This recipe turns `url 'x'` into `url = 'x'` directly inside a `maven { }` or `ivy { }` block of `repositories`, in Groovy scripts. It stays out of every other block: a `url` in a builder closure such as `pom.withXml { asNode().children().last() + { url 'x' } }` is a call that adds an XML node, and fails as an assignment. Kotlin has no such syntax. See the [Gradle 8.14 upgrade guide](https://docs.gradle.org/8.14/userguide/upgrading_version_8.html#groovy_space_assignment_syntax) for more information.

name: org.openrewrite.gradle.migrate.artifacts.UseExtendsFromForConfigurationDependencies
displayName: Use `extendsFrom` instead of a `Configuration` as a dependency
description: Gradle 8.0 no longer allows a `Configuration` in the `dependencies { }` block, failing with `Adding a Configuration as a dependency is no longer allowed as of Gradle 8.0`. What such a declaration did was make the configuration extend the other one, so this recipe writes that in a `configurations { }` block in front of the `dependencies { }` block. It acts on `implementation configurations.foo` in Groovy, and on `implementation(foo)` in Kotlin where `foo` is declared by `configurations.creating` or `configurations.create`. A declaration with a configuration closure, a configuration of another project, and a name the script also uses for a variable are left alone. See the [Gradle upgrade guide](https://docs.gradle.org/current/userguide/upgrading_version_7.html#v7_configurations_no_longer_allowed_as_dependencies) for more information.

name: org.openrewrite.gradle.migrate.artifacts.UseGetOnConfigurationAccessors
displayName: Call `get()` on Kotlin DSL configuration accessors
description: Gradle 8.0 removed the Kotlin DSL extensions that let a script reach the members of a `Configuration` directly from a `NamedDomainObjectProvider<Configuration>`, so `configurations.compileClasspath.files` fails to compile with `Unresolved reference: files`. Values obtained from `by configurations.creating` or `getByName(..)` are already a `Configuration`, and don't have this shape. name: org.openrewrite.gradle.migrate.artifacts.UseMavenCentralInsteadOfJcenter
description: `RepositoryHandler.jcenter()` was deprecated in Gradle 7.0 and removed in Gradle 9.0. A plain `jcenter()` is deleted when its `repositories` block already declares a plain `mavenCentral()`, and renamed otherwise, so that a repository with a content filter never ends up as the only way to reach artifacts it filters out. Build and settings scripts are both covered. See the [Gradle upgrade guide](https://docs.gradle.org/current/userguide/upgrading_major_version_9.html) for more information.

name: org.openrewrite.gradle.migrate.artifacts.UseProjectDependencyInsteadOfModuleCoordinates
displayName: Use `project(...)` dependency notation instead of the current project's module coordinates
description: Gradle 9.3 deprecates depending on the current project by its own `group:name:version` module coordinates. name: org.openrewrite.gradle.migrate.artifacts.UseProjectForSourceSets
description: Replace direct Groovy `compileOnly project(':path').sourceSets.main.runtimeClasspath` declarations with the project's consumable `runtimeElements` dependency and task-backed main output. This retains classes, resources and runtime dependencies without resolving another project's configuration, which Gradle 9 forbids during parallel execution.
